value.name: requests folder contents
value.description: Lucia asks Asha to show her what is inside the folder.
evidence: she needed Lucia to show her what was inside

value.name: opens folder carefully
value.description: Asha opens the folder slowly, revealing the journal and a typed page.
evidence: Asha set her thumb under the folder's flap and lifted it back without hurry, letting the journal's leather corner slide free of the cardboard pocket and the loose typed page settle against the wood beside it.

value.name: avoids looking at papers
value.description: Asha deliberately does not lean over the papers, signaling restraint or caution.
evidence: She did not lean over the papers

value.name: glances toward doorway
value.description: Asha briefly looks toward the doorway, prompting Daniel to move.
evidence: she let her eyes drift up once, briefly, to the doorway

value.name: Daniel approaches table
value.description: Daniel takes Asha's glance as a cue and moves forward toward the table.
evidence: Daniel took that as the cue he had been waiting for. He let go of the chair-back and came forward two careful steps, stopping short of the table

value.name: watches page from shadow
value.description: Daniel stops at the table and watches the typed page from partial shadow, tense and uncertain.
evidence: from that half-shadow he watched the page the way a man watches a door he is no longer sure he can close

value.name: holds position in silence
value.description: Lucia remains across the table with her hands on the folder and her breath held, showing continued tension.
evidence: Lucia stayed where she was on the other side of the table, her palms still flat where the folder had been, and the small held breath in her shoulders did not go out
